chapter_title: To the debtor when his debt is settled

duas.text: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik, innamā jazā'us-salafi 'l-ḥamdu wa'l-adā'.
duas.text_arabic: بارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك، إِنَّما جَـزاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ والأَداء
duas.translation: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).
duas.source_reference: See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/55
